title: Blender bake tool defaults to a hardcoded absolute worktree path and writes the shipped asset into a different checkout
evidence:
WT = os.environ.get("PP_WT") or "/Users/moses/.herdr/worktrees/packet-plumber/packet-plumber-v2-dublin-map-beautify"  # the packet-plumber root (PP_WT overrides)
...
scn.render.filepath = os.path.join(WT, "assets", "maps", "dublin_underlay.png")
os.makedirs(os.path.join(WT, "assets", "maps"), exist_ok=True)
bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
detail: Committed tool's default writes outputs — including the shipped 9MB underlay asset and .scratch payloads — to an absolute user-specific path of ANOTHER checkout (verified to exist on this machine; this worktree is .../perkins-packet-plumber-v2-dublin-map-beautify-r1). Silent cross-checkout contamination; breaks on any other machine.
recommended_fix: Default WT to the script's own repo root (os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))/../..) instead of an absolute path, or abort with an error when PP_WT is unset.
